omission.chore: Prevent missed schedule triggers from duplicating processing in a Shopify lead-generation workflow.
omission.evidenceQuote: Missed schedule triggers can duplicate everything.
omission.reason: This is a concrete trigger and duplicate-processing chore. The retained quote does not show that its Shopify lead-generation task is the same operational workflow as transferring phone game-test logs to Sheets, so the overlap rationale does not justify excluding it without a five-criterion assessment.
